title: Quadratic time bound for insertion sort
statement: Let $\mathit{xs}$ be a list of length $n$ over a linearly ordered type. Then the total time cost accumulated by the timed insertion sort of $\mathit{xs}$ is at most $n^2$.
hypotheses_covered: xs is a list over a linearly ordered type
n denotes the length of xs
replaced:
The time cost recorded by the timed insertion sort of a list $\mathit{xs}$ of length $n$ is at
most $n^2$.
